content_zh:
“各项能力十分平均，没有明确的缺点，也没有特定的长处。精神力……嗯，说得过去。身材比例倒还可以，长成了应该可以看看……很多块腹肌……很灵活，耐久力不错……其它的……没有了？”苏海伦从报告中抬起头，盯着大魔法师问。
在她的注视下，这位已经达到十八级魔导水准的大法师没来由的打了个冷战，恭敬地说：“这是我们目前为止所能达到的最全面检测，总计费用为十一万六千枚帝国金币。全部检测结果都在这里，暂时没有发现其它特殊天赋。”
至于苏海伦刚刚喃喃自语时说出的某些话，他自动选择了忽略和遗忘。能够修炼到十八级的魔导师，天才二字已不足以诠释他们所拥有的智慧了。
苏海伦的眉毛开始往一起凑：“按他的天赋，最多也就是能够修炼到十八级而已！根本没啥大用啊！”
十八级‘没啥大用’的魔导师认真倾听着，脸上的微笑一点不曾变化，由始至终的真挚谦逊。
“不对！他身上属于阿克蒙德的血脉力量明明非常强大纯正，甚至比小歌顿还要强些。嗯，这倒有些奇怪…….或许是被银月精灵血统所激发的结果。可是怎么会没有其它特殊天赋呢？”苏海伦两道小眉毛紧紧的绞在了一起。
魔导师认真温和说：“阿克蒙德属于上位血脉，想要检测血脉天赋的话，暂时超出了我们的能力。”
“胡说！”苏海伦怒斥，“我明明记得至少有六种方法可以检测出上位血脉天赋！就是顶层血脉也有可能测定的！上位血脉有多么重要，难道还要我再提醒你们吗？！你们都在干些什么，我的金币难道都扔到狗身上去了！既然他很可能会有上位血脉天赋，那就应该不惜一切代价去检测，根本不需要来问我！听懂我的话了吗，不惜代价！”
“其中最便宜的方法，实验费用也要超过六十万帝国金币。”听懂了的魔导师不动声色地提醒。
“哦，那就算了！”
李察并不知道幕后这些小小的插曲，被带到自己的区域后，经受了一天惨痛折磨的他立刻进入梦乡。
在梦中，他又回到了鲁瑟兰村，背着沉重的面包果正要回家。那栋温馨的小楼已经遥遥在望，而妈妈正在门口等着自己。远远的传来烤馅饼的香味，说明这个晚上他终于可以摆脱涩而无味的面包果了。小李察开心的飞奔起来，只见妈妈向自己笑了笑，就转身走进小楼。转眼间，烈焰就从每个窗户中喷出！
李察猛然坐起，惊叫着，想要向前扑去。好不容易他才看清了自己所处的环境，于是汗水瞬间汹涌透出，浸湿了睡衣。他大口大口的喘着气，胸口沉重得象压了铅块，几乎窒息。李察慢慢抬头，看到自已正躺在一张华丽大床上。床大得不可思议，至少可以供五六个人同时入眠。卧室的面积也非常大，李察只是扫了一眼，视线所及处立刻得出了精确的数据，这是20*15米的庞大空间，外加距离地面足有六米高的天花板，躺在这里的李察觉得自己就象是漂浮在大海中的孤舟。卧室的面积就已经比村长的家还要大了，李察无法想象这么大的空间为什么会只用来供一个人睡觉。
他想了想，就下了床，开始观察着卧室中的一切。距离那场大火已经过去一个月了，小李察一直强迫自己忘记那天发生过的一切。他的想法有些天真，以为只要自己忘记了，有一天妈妈就会回来。可是这个念头只要一浮上来，他就立刻强迫自己相信了它，现在更是把它当成了一种信仰。
卧室的陈设同样奢华，装饰物的选用兼有魔法师和大贵族的风格。而李察发现，只要自己用心看着什么，就会得到那件东西的许多数据，并且这些数据可以精确到小数点后两位。那是从启迪中得到的‘真实’天赋，不知道在检测的时候发生了什么，竟然刺激它成长到了第二层：“精确”。而当“精确”出现之后，李察又隐隐感觉到了它的第三和第四层能力，分别是可以分析物体内部结构的透视，以及分析材质的鉴定。不过想要发展到更高层的能力还不知道要到什么时候。

content_en:
"All abilities are very average, with no clear shortcomings and no specific strengths. Mental strength... well, that's fair. The body proportions are not bad, and you should be able to see... a lot of abdominal muscles when you grow up... very flexible, and good durability... the others... are gone?" Su Hailun raised her head from the report and stared at the great magician and asked.
Under her gaze, the archmage who had reached level 18 magic shivered for no reason and said respectfully: "This is the most comprehensive test we can achieve so far. The total cost is 116,000 imperial gold coins. All the test results are here. No other special talents have been found yet."
As for some of the words Su Hailun just murmured to himself, he automatically chose to ignore and forget them. For magisters who can cultivate to level 18, the word genius is no longer enough to explain the wisdom they possess.
Su Hailun's eyebrows began to come together: "According to his talent, he can only cultivate to level 18 at most! It's not of much use at all!"
The eighteenth-level 'useless' magister listened carefully, the smile on his face never changed at all, and he remained sincere and humble from beginning to end.
"No! The blood power of Archimonde in him is obviously very powerful and pure, even stronger than Little Gordon. Well, this is a bit strange... maybe it is the result of being inspired by the Silver Moon Elf blood. But how come he doesn't have other special talents?" Su Hailun's two little eyebrows were tightly knitted together.
The magister said seriously and gently: "Archimonde belongs to a high-ranking bloodline. If we want to test the bloodline talent, it is temporarily beyond our ability."
"Nonsense!" Su Hailun yelled angrily, "I clearly remember that there are at least six ways to detect high-level bloodline talents! Even top-level bloodlines can be tested! How important high-level bloodlines are, do you still need me to remind you?! What are you doing? Have I thrown all my gold coins at the dog! Since he is likely to have high-level bloodline talents, he should be tested at all costs. There is no need to ask me! Do you understand me, no matter the cost!"
"The cheapest method among them will cost more than 600,000 imperial gold coins for the experiment." The magister who understood it calmly reminded.
"Oh, forget it!"
Richard didn't know about these little episodes behind the scenes. After being taken to his area, he immediately fell asleep after enduring a day of painful torture.
In the dream, he returned to the village of Rutherland and was about to go home carrying a heavy load of breadfruit. The cozy little building was already in sight, and her mother was waiting for her at the door. The smell of baking pies could be heard in the distance, indicating that this evening he could finally get rid of the astringent and tasteless breadfruit. Little Richard ran happily. When his mother smiled at him, he turned around and walked into the small building. In the blink of an eye, flames were shooting out of every window!
Richard sat up suddenly, screamed, and wanted to rush forward. It took him a long time to see clearly the environment he was in, and sweat suddenly poured out, soaking his pajamas. He was panting heavily, his chest was as heavy as a lead weight, and he was almost suffocating. Richard slowly raised his head and saw that he was lying on a gorgeous bed. The bed is incredibly big and can accommodate at least five or six people sleeping at the same time. The bedroom was also very large. Richard just glanced at it and immediately got accurate data wherever he looked. It was a huge space of 20*15 meters, plus a ceiling six meters high from the ground. Lying here, Richard felt like a lonely boat floating in the sea. The bedroom area was already larger than the village chief's home. Richard couldn't imagine why such a large space could only be used for one person to sleep.
After thinking about it, he got out of bed and began to observe everything in the bedroom. A month has passed since the fire, and Little Richard has been forcing himself to forget what happened that day.cut. He was a little naive, thinking that as long as he forgot, his mother would come back one day. But as soon as this idea came up, he immediately forced himself to believe it, and now he regarded it as a belief.
The furnishings of the bedroom are equally luxurious, and the decorations are chosen in the style of both magicians and nobles. And Richard discovered that as long as he looked at something carefully, he would get a lot of data about that thing, and these data could be accurate to two decimal places. That is the 'real' talent obtained from enlightenment. I don't know what happened during the detection, but it actually stimulated it to grow to the second level: "precision". And when "Accuracy" appeared, Richard vaguely felt its third and fourth levels of ability, which were perspective analysis of the internal structure of objects and identification of materials. But I don’t know how long it will take to develop to higher-level abilities.
